title: Fairflow: information for players
summary: Playing is part of your course. The game records which irrigation scheme you play and your moves, never your name.
summaryResearch: Separately, you choose whether your table's record may be used for research. Nobody at the table, and not the facilitator, sees your answer.

sections.heading: What this is
sections.text: Fairflow is a water-sharing game played in [COURSE NAME]. Playing is part of the course.

sections.heading: Research
sections.text: Separately, [RESEARCHER NAME(S)] at IHE Delft study how players share water and what they learn. Helping the research is your choice.

sections.heading: What the game records
sections.text: Which irrigation scheme you play, your votes, pumping, predictions and other moves, when you made each one, and anything you type in the review. It does not ask your name; please do not type names or personal details.

sections.heading: Who sees what
sections.text: Your table sees shared results; at the debrief it may see each scheme's pumping. Only you see your review answers. The facilitator knows who sat at which scheme. If the facilitator saves the debrief screen, that copy shows schemes, never names.

sections.heading: If you say yes to research
sections.text: Your table's record is kept without names and used for research and publications. Typed answers are checked and anything identifying is removed. If anyone at your table says no, that table's record is not used. Nobody at the table, and not the facilitator, sees your choice, and it does not affect your grade.

sections.heading: Changing your mind
sections.text: Write to [CONTACT E-MAIL] with your room code, scheme and date before [DATE WHEN THE LINK IS REMOVED]. After that, the record cannot be traced to you.

sections.heading: Data protection
sections.text: Controller: [LEGAL NAME OF CONTROLLER]. Legal basis: [LEGAL BASIS]. The game record is kept on a server run by [INSTITUTE] in [EU COUNTRY] and is deleted automatically 24 hours after the game's last move. Your rights and the data protection officer: [DPO CONTACT; PRIVACY STATEMENT LINK]. You may complain to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens. [ETHICS APPROVAL: REFERENCE, IF RESEARCH IS ENABLED].

part1: I have read the information and I will take part in the game.
part2: May your table's game record, without your name, be used for research?
withdrawal: Keep this if you want to withdraw from the research later.
